'''Rotta'''<!-- ANY ATTEMPTS TO MOVE THE PAGE TO OR ADD "ROTTA DESILIJIC TIURE" WILL BE TREATED AS FANON. WE DON'T KNOW HOW HUTT NAMES WORK -->, nicknamed "'''Pedunkee Mufkin'''", translated as "Punky Muffin", by his father and "'''Stinky'''" by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], was a [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]] born into the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the offspring of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], grandson of [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]], great-nephew of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]], [[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron|Jiliac]], and [[Pazda Desilijic Tiure|Pazda]], and cousin of [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga]] and [[Grubba Desilijic Aarrpo]].

==Biography==
===Origins===
Rotta was born around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Birth" /> to the well-known [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and [[Kajidii/Legends|kajidii]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]].<ref name="SW:TCWf" /> As the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] were biologically [[Reproduction/Legends|hermaphroditic]],<ref>[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> Jabba was both Rotta's [[Parent/Legends|father and mother]].<ref name="Databank" /> Unlike most Huttlets, Rotta did not spend the first fifty years of his life inside his parent's [[Brood pouch/Legends|brood pouch]], as his father Jabba wanted him to directly experience [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] firsthand from birth, a practice virtually unheard of in modern Hutt society.<ref name="TCW:TVG" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|I love that Huttlet.|Ziro, claiming to love his great-nephew|audio=ILoveThatHuttlet-TCWf.flac|<ref name="SW:TCWf" />}}
[[File:Octopus ship capture.png|left|thumb|270x270px|The capture of Rotta.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="essential">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], aged just 10 [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] old, Rotta took part in a pleasure cruise on his father's barge, when his escort skiffs were attacked. With a sole survivor left to share the news with Jabba, the Huttlet was kidnapped by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] at the direction of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], and in cooperation with Rotta's great-uncle, [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]]. Taken aboard the [[Trident (starship)/Legends|''Trident'']], he was flown to the [[B'omarr Monastery]] on the planet [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. The kidnapping prompted Jabba to make a deal with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to rescue his son, in turn for free passage through his shipping routes.<ref name="SW:TCWf" />

While being held prisoner on Teth, Rotta became sick,<ref name="SW:TCWf" /> as the move from arid [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to cool, wet [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] had made him sick, as including the stress of being kidnapped.<ref name="TCW:TVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> Sometime after his imprisonment, Rotta's cell door was opened and the distressed Huttlet started to wail when he saw [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Before leaving, Ahsoka commented upon Rotta by saying he was "so cute", to which Skywalker replied by saying that Rotta would not be so cute when he grew up. However, while being taken back to the monastery's front exterior, Ahsoka realized that Rotta was sick and informed her master, prompting Skywalker to call for a backpack to put Rotta in. However, [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] reinforcements arrived and attacked the [[Squad/Legends|squad]], prompting Rotta and the others to go back inside. While [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] stayed at the entrance, Rotta, who was still being carried by Ahsoka, Skywalker, and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], went deeper into the monastery. They eventually stopped in the throne room; by this time, Rotta was asleep and Ahsoka put him down onto the throne.<ref name="SW:TCWf" />

At some point, Rotta woke up and started to crawl under the throne. When [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex, under the influence of Ventress, called for their position, Skywalker went looking for Rotta and dragged him out from under the throne. Once the group made it to the docking station at the back of the monastery, they were confronted by Ventress and two [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], which prompted R2-D2 to close the door. When Skywalker said that they had run out of options, Rotta wailed, pointing out to the others that there was another docking station with a ship on it. After a duel ended between Ventress &mdash; who cut through the door R2-D2 had previously locked &mdash; and Tano, Rotta and the others flew to the docking station via [[Can-cell/Legends|can-cells]]. Once at the docking station, Skywalker had R2 carry Rotta, with Ahsoka destroying several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[4A-7/Legends|another droid]]. R2 then carried Rotta onboard the ship, though once on board, Skywalker continuously tried to help his troops, endangering Rotta's safety, though Ahsoka convinced him not to.<ref name="SW:TCWf" />

While heading towards [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|their ship]], vulture droids chased them and ended up running into the star destroyer's side-docking doors, prompting Rotta to wail. With the group unable to take Rotta to a med station onboard the frigate, they had to take the ship to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, as Rotta's condition worsened, Tano had to go in back to look for medical supplies, and while she was gone, Anakin reassured Rotta that they would get him to his father alive, showing that he was developing a begrudging fondness for the Huttlet. With the assistance of a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]], Tano was able to successfully treat Rotta's illness, though the medication caused him to burp.<ref name="SW:TCWf" />

[[File:Padme_talks_to_Jabba.png|thumb|270x270px|Rotta, with his [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|father]], listening to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] negotiations.]]
During the trip through Hyperspace, Rotta eventually fell asleep but was eventually woken up during a dogfight between the Jedi and several [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]]. The [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] was eventually shot down in Tatooine's orbit by enemy forces. Once they crashed, Anakin took Rotta and carried him on his back and started to walk across the treacherous [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. At some point, Rotta seemed to sense the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] approaching, and hid inside Anakin's pack. To keep Rotta safe, Skywalker had his pack filled with rocks to distract Count Dooku while Tano and R2-D2 took Rotta to his father. When Magna Guards stood in their way, Tano defeated them. Ahsoka and Rotta eventually made their way to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|his father's palace]], but just as Jabba was about to have Skywalker killed, thinking the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had killed his son, Tano arrived with the lost Rotta. Jabba was overjoyed by the safety of his son and Ahsoka handed Rotta over to him after he woke up. However, once Jabba was about to have Rotta's saviors executed, he closed his eyes, but Rotta's great-uncle Ziro Desilijic Tiure called for Jabba. Instead of Ziro appearing, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] appeared and brought proof that Ziro orchestrated the kidnapping. Jabba was then willing to sign the Republic's treaty, but not before settling a score with Ziro first.<ref name="SW:TCWf" />

A [[21 BBY/Legends|year later]], when [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] arrived at Jabba's Palace searching for his daughters, Rotta was also present with his father. After the Baron's arrival, Rotta started to play with a bug and beat it to death on Jabba's tail, prompting Jabba to tell Rotta to stop. The Baron appealed to Jabba's sense of fatherhood, asking him to help him find his own missing daughters. Jabba looked to his son, smiled, and relented, allowing Papanoida to present evidence against the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], and take the Rodian with him afterward.<ref name="TCW:Sphere">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref>

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Death Sentence">''[[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Death Sentence]]'' places the [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] revival arc in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]</ref> Jabba heard of the activities of the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] and sent Rotta away from his palace before [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his criminal army arrived.<ref name="Shadow">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref>

===Post-war===
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]], Rotta's grandfather, produced Jabba's [[Jabba the Hutt's Will|Will]], which claimed that he did not have any children to run his [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]], and therefore Zorba was to inherit it.<ref name="Zorba the Hutt's Revenge">''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]''</ref> The Hutt courts later declared Jabba's "Will" a forgery.<ref name="hhh">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030911hutt|text=Hutt! Hutt! Hutt!}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Rotta_pack.png|thumb|left|180px|Rotta in a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|GAR]] [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]].]]
Born as a Hutt into the wealthy Desilijic kajidic, Rotta appeared to often be pampered by his father, the successful crimelord Kajidii Jabba Desilijic Tiure, as demonstrated when Rotta was on a cruise by himself with two skiff escorts.<ref name="SW:TCWf" /> Rotta appeared to often be scared at some points, though had good reasons to be too. Even though Rotta was young, he was able to solve problems easily when others could not, as was shown when Ahsoka and Anakin could not solve the problem of being trapped by Ventress, but Rotta could.<ref name="SW:TCWf" /> Rotta also appeared to be very cheerful and easily amused, for example, when Anakin had his "we're in trouble look", Rotta and Ahsoka were amused when Tano said that they couldn't miss it.<ref name="SW:TCWf" />

Rotta had grayish-green colored skin, with orange-brown eyes. Rotta was also small,<ref name="SW:TCWf" /> with 0.43 meters as his height.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rotta's name was first found in a preliminary image of an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] set to be released under the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|Clone Wars TV series]] line.<ref>{{OfficialBlog|url=2008/02/01/lego-previews-at-uk-toy-fair|text=LEGO Previews at UK Toy Fair}}</ref> A [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|Clone Wars action figure]] card confirmed him as the son of Jabba.<ref>{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2008 Basic Figure|pack=#01: Anakin Skywalker (Firing Force Blast!)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW01anakin.asp}}</ref>

In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a backpack was sold during the 2009 [[Galactic Moon Festival]] resembling a plush Rotta in the GAR backpack. However, the Republic symbol is replaced with the glowing moon and bat of the Galactic Moon Festival.<ref>{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
